Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 4 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Shear Line
Issued at: 2:00 AM, 25 November 2025(Tuesday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Quezon, Laguna, Rizal, Metro Manila, Cavite, Batangas, Bulacan and Nueva Ecija(General Tinio, Bongabon, Palayan, Gabaldon, Laur, Gapan, Penaranda).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Zambales and Bataan within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Tarlac, Pampanga and Nueva Ecija(Cabiao, San Antonio, San Isidro, Aliaga, Cabanatuan, Carranglan, Cuyapo, General Mamerto Natividad, Guimba, Jaen, Licab, Llanera, Lupao, Nampicuan, Pantabangan, Quezon, Rizal, San Jose, San Leonardo, Santa Rosa, Santo Domingo, Munoz, Talavera, Talugtug, Zaragoza) which may persist within 3 hours.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 5:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.

When I first looked into @VenomFoundation, the best way I could understand it was by thinking about a busy city. 

You know how a city has one main road that connects everything, but also a bunch of side roads that help ease traffic. That is exactly how Venom works. 

The masterchain is the main road. The workchains are the side roads. Everything stays organized, and nothing gets stuck.

What impressed me most is how Venom handles pressure. When the network gets busy, it opens more lanes so everything keeps moving. 

When things slow down, it closes the extra lanes to save resources. 

That is dynamic sharding, and it is the reason Venom stays fast and cheap at the same time.

Then I saw where Venom is being used. The Philippines is using it to digitize huge national records. 

The UAE uses it for carbon credit tracking. Africa is building with it too. It feels different when a blockchain is solving real problems, not just hype.

I like that I can use it right away. The wallet is simple. The explorer is clean. Staking is available if you want to earn while supporting the network. It made the whole ecosystem feel real and accessible, even for beginners.

Sure, the network is still young, and adoption needs to grow. But the mission is clear. 

@VenomFoundation wants to make digital systems faster and more reliable for everyone, from governments to regular users like us.
